description: Someone with no one left is being carried through the meat district and the family that isn't there paid for a crowd. Walk Cinder Lane, then Marrow Street, and look devastated. Tears optional but appreciated. 20₵.
name: Professional Mourner

emotes: {who} dabs at dry eyes on Cinder Lane and lets out a wail that echoes convincingly.
{who} walks the procession with head bowed, sneaking glances to see if anyone's watching.
{who} clutches a stranger's coat and sobs the name off the toe-tag: 'Oh... Number Forty-One...'
{who} keens down Marrow Street, really committing now, working for the bonus.
{who} throws a handful of gravel like flower petals and calls it a tribute.
{who} wipes away a tear that turns out to be someone else's blood, and grieves harder.
